scientific_integrity: A finite exact-rational interval certificate proves a strict correlation reversal. An analytical dominated-convergence argument proves the asymptotic mechanism; finite computational checks do not stand in for an infinite proof. Mathematical priority is subject to unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: The finite counterexample is for theta=15 with two identically distributed twenty-level integer-valued margins; it does not determine minimal categories, optimal thresholds, or a full positive-parameter phase diagram. High-theta existence uses a smooth-transform asymptotic and pointwise-in-parameter finite quantizer convergence. No independent audit has been performed.
title: A certified ordinal Frank-copula counterexample and its high-dependence mechanism
